entries.back_en: "Huh? This is a strange question.[02]Here is Sonne Village.[01]Capital? Ah, it's far away, to the east, friend."
"Oh boy...I didn't want the landlord to see anything about you...."
entries.note: 'find out about' vira 'visse nada sobre', leve mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: "Well...It'll probably be fine, as long as we keep pretending you're my cousin...You should worry more about yourself than me! Your wound isn't fully healed! You shouldn't be walking around in first place!"
entries.note: 'in th' first place' ficou literal 'em primeiro lugar'; ideia é 'para começo de conversa'.

entries.back_en: "Calling you my cousin was the first thing I thought of...But you really are..."
"Many were the empires of the world at that time, and they made terrible war against each other."
"But even while he dreamed, [04][06] realized a terrible truth."
"Even if he were complete, he wouldn't be able to satisfy all the desires of the people!"
"Indeed. And why not? Because people are..."
"What is this!? I feel a presence...It's like one of the Eternals..."
"I believe it is not wise that thou...That we pursue this...this...relationship."
"Don't let what the landlord said bother you...Everyone in the village is grateful for what you did...And so am I..."
"It would appear I must needs fight my way out...Nay...Perhaps I can still escape unseen by those soldiers..."
"What is this? What does this village matter to me? Why do I turn around? My path is clear--defeat those troops and reach Chedo...And yet..."
entries.note: 'Why dost I hesitate?' virou 'Por que dou meia volta?' (turn around), não 'hesito'.

entries.back_en: "So this is where you were hiding him, eh?"
"H-hiding!? We didn't know he was wanted!"
"I...I told all the folks in the village to grab anything that could be used as a weapon...We'll help you capture him, all right? Heh heh..."
"Mami!?""Thou wouldst do such a thing?"
"Thou wouldst do such a thing?"
"Thou wouldst protect me--hinder their attempts to imprison me? Thou art taking a great risk. What will thy fellows think of thee?"
"And I thought, maybe if you hid out here, with me...You might be able to live a normal life...With me..."
"I know it's silly--it can't be...But I wished so hard it would!"
"Forgive me...I never should have made you stay here...!"
"Mami! What are you doing!? Open the door!!"
"Heh heh...Who'd have thought that the cracked wall would come in handy like this, eh?"
"There was only a woman in here!"
"You were hiding [04][06], weren't you? Did you...live with him?"
"Take her back to Astana. Maybe we can use her in the Carronade."
"It...It's not my fault......It's your fault, Mami...You shouldn't have done that..."
"Who are you? Where do you come from, eh? We don't like strangers here..."
"What was that rumbling a while back?"
entries.note: 'tem um tempo atrás' agramatical; usar 'há um tempo atrás'.
